inputs.text: [excited] MIN… mee. [curious] This name isn't Greek or Latin — it's a place in Australia, Minmi Crossing, [pauses] where its bones were found.
[playful] "Paravertebra." [confident] "Para," in Latin, means next to. And "vertebra" is the vertebra — the little bones of the back.

[warmly] That's it — tiny ones, never seen anywhere else. It lived in Queensland, [amazed] a hundred twenty million years ago, [pauses] and for a long time, it was the shortest dinosaur name in the world.
